rationale: The question is partially addressed by several papers: 2607.27531 and 2402.13931 discuss the impact of stellar radiation on atmospheric evolution, 2607.03874 examines star-planet interactions, 2609.31859 investigates atmospheric escape due to variable X-ray flux, and 2607.11531 reviews the evolution of rocky planet atmospheres. These contributions provide substantive evidence on different aspects of the question but do not fully settle it.
